q: 他的房间___的，衣服和书到处都是。
zh: 他的房间乱七八糟的，衣服和书到处都是。
py: tā de fáng jiān luàn qī bā zāo de yī fu hé shū dào chù dōu shì
en: His room is a total mess, with clothes and books everywhere.
why: Clothes and books everywhere describe a total mess, 乱七八糟. 一丝不苟 and 十全十美 describe the opposite: neat, careful, flawless.

q: 新搬来的邻居把楼道堆得___，大家都不高兴。
zh: 新搬来的邻居把楼道堆得乱七八糟，大家都不高兴。
py: xīn bān lái de lín jū bǎ lóu dào duī de luàn qī bā zāo dà jiā dōu bù gāo xìng
en: The new neighbour piled things up in the stairwell in a complete mess, and everyone was unhappy.
why: 堆得乱七八糟 says the stuff is piled up in a mess, which explains why people are unhappy. 十全十美 and 津津有味 cannot describe how things are piled up.

q: 妈妈说我做事___，连门都忘了锁。
zh: 妈妈说我做事马马虎虎，连门都忘了锁。
py: mā ma shuō wǒ zuò shì mǎ ma hǔ hǔ lián mén dōu wàng le suǒ
en: Mum says I'm careless; I even forgot to lock the door.
why: Forgetting to lock the door is the proof of careless work, 马马虎虎. The other three all praise care or effort and would not be followed by 连门都忘了锁.

q: 爸爸总是___，不是忘了带钥匙，就是忘了带手机。
zh: 爸爸总是丢三落四，不是忘了带钥匙，就是忘了带手机。
py: bà ba zǒng shì diū sān là sì bù shì wàng le dài yào shi jiù shì wàng le dài shǒu jī
en: Dad is always forgetting things: if it's not his keys, it's his phone.
why: Forgetting one thing after another is 丢三落四 (落 is là). 一丝不苟 is the opposite, and 半途而废 and 七上八下 do not describe forgetfulness.

q: 客人突然来了，妈妈___地收拾起客厅来。
zh: 客人突然来了，妈妈手忙脚乱地收拾起客厅来。
py: kè rén tū rán lái le mā ma shǒu máng jiǎo luàn de shōu shi qǐ kè tīng lái
en: The guests turned up suddenly, and Mum rushed around in a flap tidying the living room.
why: Sudden guests and a quick tidy-up give a flustered scramble, 手忙脚乱 + 地 before the verb. The distractors do not describe a way of tidying.

q: 小王上课___，一会儿看手机，一会儿看窗外。
zh: 小王上课三心二意，一会儿看手机，一会儿看窗外。
py: xiǎo wáng shàng kè sān xīn èr yì yī huì r kàn shǒu jī yī huì r kàn chuāng wài
en: Xiao Wang is half-hearted in class: one moment he looks at his phone, the next out of the window.
why: Switching attention from phone to window is 三心二意. 聚精会神 and 废寝忘食 mean total absorption and 一丝不苟 means meticulous care, all the opposite of this picture.

q: 你别___了，那首歌不是她唱的，是另一个歌手唱的。
zh: 你别张冠李戴了，那首歌不是她唱的，是另一个歌手唱的。
py: nǐ bié zhāng guān lǐ dài le nà shǒu gē bù shì tā chàng de shì lìng yī gè gē shǒu chàng de
en: Don't mix them up: she didn't sing that song, another singer did.
why: Crediting the song to the wrong singer is 张冠李戴, mixing up who did what. 画蛇添足 is adding something needless, which does not fit.

q: 这家饭店的服务员做事___，上错了三个菜。
zh: 这家饭店的服务员做事马马虎虎，上错了三个菜。
py: zhè jiā fàn diàn de fú wù yuán zuò shì mǎ ma hǔ hǔ shàng cuò le sān gè cài
en: The waiters at this restaurant are careless; they served three wrong dishes.
why: Three wrong dishes show careless work, 马马虎虎. 一丝不苟 and 十全十美 would be praise and contradict the mistakes.

q: “你的钢琴弹得怎么样？”“___，还要多练习。”
zh: “你的钢琴弹得怎么样？”“马马虎虎，还要多练习。”
py: nǐ de gāng qín tán de zěn me yàng mǎ ma hǔ hǔ hái yào duō liàn xí
en: “How is your piano playing?” “So-so; I need more practice.”
why: As a modest answer, 马马虎虎 means so-so, which is why 还要多练习 follows. 十全十美 (perfect) would contradict that.

q: 他学吉他___，一边弹一边玩手机。
zh: 他学吉他三心二意，一边弹一边玩手机。
py: tā xué jí tā sān xīn èr yì yī biān tán yī biān wán shǒu jī
en: He learns the guitar half-heartedly, playing while fiddling with his phone.
why: Playing while on the phone is divided attention, 三心二意. The other three mean full focus or total devotion.

q: 搬家那天，客厅里___的，到处都是箱子。
zh: 搬家那天，客厅里乱七八糟的，到处都是箱子。
py: bān jiā nà tiān kè tīng li luàn qī bā zāo de dào chù dōu shì xiāng zi
en: On moving day the living room was a mess, with boxes everywhere.
why: Boxes everywhere make the room 乱七八糟的. The other idioms describe manner or feeling, not the state of a room.

q: 这张照片的说明写错了人，把弟弟说成了哥哥，真是___。
zh: 这张照片的说明写错了人，把弟弟说成了哥哥，真是张冠李戴。
py: zhè zhāng zhào piàn de shuō míng xiě cuò le rén bǎ dì di shuō chéng le gē ge zhēn shì zhāng guān lǐ dài
en: The caption names the wrong person, calling the younger brother the older one; a real mix-up.
why: Giving one person's identity to another is exactly 张冠李戴 (hat of Zhang on Li). The other idioms have nothing to do with a wrong attribution.

q: 我一向___，所以出门前都要检查一遍包。
zh: 我一向丢三落四，所以出门前都要检查一遍包。
py: wǒ yī xiàng diū sān là sì suǒ yǐ chū mén qián dōu yào jiǎn chá yī biàn bāo
en: I've always been forgetful, so I check my bag before I leave the house.
why: Checking the bag is the reaction to being forgetful, 丢三落四. The distractors do not give a reason for checking.

q: 闹钟没响，我___地穿好衣服，没吃早饭就冲出了门。
zh: 闹钟没响，我手忙脚乱地穿好衣服，没吃早饭就冲出了门。
py: nào zhōng méi xiǎng wǒ shǒu máng jiǎo luàn de chuān hǎo yī fu méi chī zǎo fàn jiù chōng chū le mén
en: The alarm didn't go off, so I flung my clothes on in a panic and dashed out without breakfast.
why: Dashing out with no breakfast describes a panicked rush, 手忙脚乱. 小心翼翼 (very carefully) and the happy or relishing idioms clash with the hurry.

q: 地铁里大家都在看手机，只有那个学生___地看书。
zh: 地铁里大家都在看手机，只有那个学生聚精会神地看书。
py: dì tiě li dà jiā dōu zài kàn shǒu jī zhǐ yǒu nà ge xué sheng jù jīng huì shén de kàn shū
en: On the metro everyone is on their phone; only that student is reading with total concentration.
why: Reading while everyone else is distracted points to full concentration, 聚精会神 + 地. The others do not fit quiet reading.

q: 为了考上大学，他___地复习，连周末都不休息。
zh: 为了考上大学，他废寝忘食地复习，连周末都不休息。
py: wèi le kǎo shàng dà xué tā fèi qǐn wàng shí de fù xí lián zhōu mò dōu bù xiū xi
en: To get into university he revised like mad, not even resting at the weekend.
why: Not even resting at the weekend shows he forgets sleep and food, 废寝忘食. 三心二意 and 无所谓 are the opposite of this effort.

q: 这家建筑公司做事___，每一块砖都要检查三遍。
zh: 这家建筑公司做事一丝不苟，每一块砖都要检查三遍。
py: zhè jiā jiàn zhù gōng sī zuò shì yī sī bù gǒu měi yī kuài zhuān dōu yào jiǎn chá sān biàn
en: This construction company is meticulous: every brick is checked three times.
why: Checking every brick three times is meticulous care, 一丝不苟. All three distractors are careless, the opposite.

q: 这次演出很重要，我们一定要___。
zh: 这次演出很重要，我们一定要全力以赴。
py: zhè cì yǎn chū hěn zhòng yào wǒ men yī dìng yào quán lì yǐ fù
en: This performance matters, so we must give it everything.
why: An important event calls for going all out, 全力以赴. 半途而废 (giving up halfway) after 一定要 would be absurd.

q: 他学了三个月的小提琴，觉得太难就不学了，真是___。
zh: 他学了三个月的小提琴，觉得太难就不学了，真是半途而废。
py: tā xué le sān gè yuè de xiǎo tí qín jué de tài nán jiù bù xué le zhēn shì bàn tú ér fèi
en: He learned the violin for three months, found it too hard and quit; what a case of giving up halfway.
why: Quitting because it is hard is 半途而废. 全力以赴 and 一丝不苟 praise effort, and 熟能生巧 is about improving through practice.

q: 为了买到演唱会的票，他___地托朋友帮忙。
zh: 为了买到演唱会的票，他千方百计地托朋友帮忙。
py: wèi le mǎi dào yǎn chàng huì de piào tā qiān fāng bǎi jì de tuō péng you bāng máng
en: To get a concert ticket he tried every possible way, asking friends for help.
why: Trying every route to reach a goal is 千方百计. 无所谓 (doesn't matter) contradicts 为了买到票.

q: 写新闻报道要___，不能夸大。
zh: 写新闻报道要实事求是，不能夸大。
py: xiě xīn wén bào dào yào shí shì qiú shì bù néng kuā dà
en: News reports must stick to the facts and not exaggerate.
why: Not exaggerating means sticking to the facts, 实事求是. The distractors describe moods or giving up, not a standard for writing.

q: 他看书___，连我走进房间都没发现。
zh: 他看书聚精会神，连我走进房间都没发现。
py: tā kàn shū jù jīng huì shén lián wǒ zǒu jìn fáng jiān dōu méi fā xiàn
en: He read with such concentration that he didn't even notice me come into the room.
why: Not noticing someone enter is the result of full concentration, 聚精会神. 三心二意 would mean he is easily distracted, so he would notice.

q: 老师说，学外语不能___，要坚持每天练习。
zh: 老师说，学外语不能半途而废，要坚持每天练习。
py: lǎo shī shuō xué wài yǔ bù néng bàn tú ér fèi yào jiān chí měi tiān liàn xí
en: The teacher says you mustn't give up halfway when learning a language; keep practising every day.
why: The advice to keep going every day warns against 半途而废. The other idioms do not connect to persisting.

q: 为了写好这本小说，作家___地工作了两年。
zh: 为了写好这本小说，作家废寝忘食地工作了两年。
py: wèi le xiě hǎo zhè běn xiǎo shuō zuò jiā fèi qǐn wàng shí de gōng zuò le liǎng nián
en: To write this novel well, the author worked for two years, forgetting to eat and sleep.
why: Two years of obsessive work is 废寝忘食 + 地 before 工作. The distractors cannot modify a verb of working this way.

q: 她修改歌词时___，一个字也不放过。
zh: 她修改歌词时一丝不苟，一个字也不放过。
py: tā xiū gǎi gē cí shí yī sī bù gǒu yī gè zì yě bù fàng guò
en: She is meticulous when revising lyrics, letting not a single word slip by.
why: Not letting one word pass is meticulousness, 一丝不苟. 马马虎虎 here would be careless, which contradicts 一个字也不放过.

q: 房东___想把房子租出去，价钱一降再降。
zh: 房东千方百计想把房子租出去，价钱一降再降。
py: fáng dōng qiān fāng bǎi jì xiǎng bǎ fáng zi zū chū qù jià qián yī jiàng zài jiàng
en: The landlord is trying every trick to rent the flat out, lowering the price again and again.
why: Dropping the price again and again shows he is trying every possible way, 千方百计. 无所谓 would mean he doesn't care, the opposite.

q: 足球赛已经开始了，球员们___，都想赢。
zh: 足球赛已经开始了，球员们全力以赴，都想赢。
py: zú qiú sài yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le qiú yuán men quán lì yǐ fù dōu xiǎng yíng
en: The match has begun and the players give it everything, all wanting to win.
why: Everyone wanting to win means giving everything, 全力以赴. 无所谓 (don't care) and 半途而废 contradict 都想赢.

q: 孩子们听说周末去动物园，一个个___。
zh: 孩子们听说周末去动物园，一个个兴高采烈。
py: hái zi men tīng shuō zhōu mò qù dòng wù yuán yī gè gè xìng gāo cǎi liè
en: The children heard they were going to the zoo at the weekend and were all in high spirits.
why: A treat makes the children happy, 兴高采烈. 七上八下 is anxiety, never joy.

q: 她看着电影，___地吃着爆米花。
zh: 她看着电影，津津有味地吃着爆米花。
py: tā kàn zhe diàn yǐng jīn jīn yǒu wèi de chī zhe bào mǐ huā
en: She ate popcorn with relish as she watched the film.
why: Eating something with obvious enjoyment is 津津有味 + 地. The others do not describe a way of eating.

q: 演唱会明天就开始了，我___想听她唱新歌。
zh: 演唱会明天就开始了，我迫不及待想听她唱新歌。
py: yǎn chàng huì míng tiān jiù kāi shǐ le wǒ pò bù jí dài xiǎng tīng tā chàng xīn gē
en: The concert is tomorrow and I can't wait to hear her sing the new songs.
why: Eager anticipation of tomorrow is 迫不及待. The distractors do not express eagerness.

q: 他___地抱着刚出生的女儿，生怕弄疼她。
zh: 他小心翼翼地抱着刚出生的女儿，生怕弄疼她。
py: tā xiǎo xīn yì yì de bào zhe gāng chū shēng de nǚ ér shēng pà nòng téng tā
en: He held his newborn daughter very carefully, afraid of hurting her.
why: 生怕 (afraid that) calls for great care, 小心翼翼. The distractors cannot describe how one holds a baby.

q: 明天就要考试了，我心里___的，晚上睡不着。
zh: 明天就要考试了，我心里七上八下的，晚上睡不着。
py: míng tiān jiù yào kǎo shì le wǒ xīn li qī shàng bā xià de wǎn shang shuì bù zháo
en: The exam is tomorrow; I'm on edge and can't sleep tonight.
why: Nervous before an exam, with trouble sleeping, is 心里七上八下. 兴高采烈 is joy and does not cause sleeplessness here.

q: 听完导游的讲解，我才___：原来这座老房子是一百年前的火车站。
zh: 听完导游的讲解，我才恍然大悟：原来这座老房子是一百年前的火车站。
py: tīng wán dǎo yóu de jiǎng jiě wǒ cái huǎng rán dà wù yuán lái zhè zuò lǎo fáng zi shì yī bǎi nián qián de huǒ chē zhàn
en: Only after the guide's explanation did it dawn on me: this old house was a railway station a hundred years ago.
why: An explanation followed by 原来 gives sudden understanding, 恍然大悟. The other three are feelings, not realisations.

q: 看到最后一幕，我___，原来凶手一直就在身边。
zh: 看到最后一幕，我恍然大悟，原来凶手一直就在身边。
py: kàn dào zuì hòu yī mù wǒ huǎng rán dà wù yuán lái xiōng shǒu yī zhí jiù zài shēn biān
en: At the last scene it suddenly clicked: the killer had been right beside us all along.
why: 原来 introduces what the viewer suddenly understands, so 恍然大悟. The distractors do not mean realising something.

q: 她第一次在电影院见到他，就对他___了。
zh: 她第一次在电影院见到他，就对他一见钟情了。
py: tā dì yī cì zài diàn yǐng yuàn jiàn dào tā jiù duì tā yī jiàn zhōng qíng le
en: The first time she saw him in the cinema, she fell for him at first sight.
why: Falling in love on first meeting is 一见钟情, with 对 + person before it. The others cannot follow 对他.

q: 我对这座海边的小城___，决定在这里住下来。
zh: 我对这座海边的小城一见钟情，决定在这里住下来。
py: wǒ duì zhè zuò hǎi biān de xiǎo chéng yī jiàn zhōng qíng jué dìng zài zhè lǐ zhù xià lái
en: I fell in love with this little seaside town at first sight and decided to settle here.
why: Instant love for a place leads to the decision to stay: 对…一见钟情. The other idioms give no reason to move there.

q: 爷爷看京剧看得___，连晚饭都忘了吃。
zh: 爷爷看京剧看得津津有味，连晚饭都忘了吃。
py: yé ye kàn jīng jù kàn de jīn jīn yǒu wèi lián wǎn fàn dōu wàng le chī
en: Grandpa watched Peking opera with such relish that he forgot his dinner.
why: 看得津津有味 means watching with great enjoyment, which explains forgetting dinner. 莫名其妙 would mean he found it baffling and would not be so absorbed.

q: 我___地想回家，看看三年没见的父母。
zh: 我迫不及待地想回家，看看三年没见的父母。
py: wǒ pò bù jí dài de xiǎng huí jiā kàn kan sān nián méi jiàn de fù mǔ
en: I can't wait to go home and see my parents, whom I haven't seen for three years.
why: Three years apart explains impatience, 迫不及待. The other idioms do not express longing.

q: 他们昨天还好好的，今天却___地吵起架来。
zh: 他们昨天还好好的，今天却莫名其妙地吵起架来。
py: tā men zuó tiān hái hǎo hǎo de jīn tiān què mò míng qí miào de chǎo qǐ jià lái
en: They were fine yesterday, but today they started quarrelling for no apparent reason.
why: A quarrel after a good day, with no reason, is 莫名其妙地. 理所当然 would say the quarrel was only natural, which 却 rules out.

q: 这么小的孩子就能自己弹完一首钢琴曲，真___。
zh: 这么小的孩子就能自己弹完一首钢琴曲，真不可思议。
py: zhè me xiǎo de hái zi jiù néng zì jǐ tán wán yī shǒu gāng qín qǔ zhēn bù kě sī yì
en: A child this small can play a whole piano piece on their own; it's amazing.
why: Amazement at something surprising is 不可思议. 理所当然 and 无所谓 would treat it as normal or unimportant.

q: 孩子长大了就要离开家，这是___的事。
zh: 孩子长大了就要离开家，这是理所当然的事。
py: hái zi zhǎng dà le jiù yào lí kāi jiā zhè shì lǐ suǒ dāng rán de shì
en: Children leave home when they grow up; that is only natural.
why: 是…的事 with something that goes without saying takes 理所当然. 莫名其妙的事 would call it senseless, which clashes with the sentence.

q: “我们去看电影还是去逛街？”“都___，你决定吧。”
zh: “我们去看电影还是去逛街？”“都无所谓，你决定吧。”
py: wǒ men qù kàn diàn yǐng hái shi qù guàng jiē dōu wú suǒ wèi nǐ jué dìng ba
en: “Shall we see a film or go shopping?” “Either is fine, you decide.”
why: 都无所谓 means both options are fine with me, so the choice is yours. The other idioms make no sense as an answer to a choice question.

q: 这家餐厅的菜、服务和环境都很好，几乎___。
zh: 这家餐厅的菜、服务和环境都很好，几乎十全十美。
py: zhè jiā cān tīng de cài fú wù hé huán jìng dōu hěn hǎo jī hū shí quán shí měi
en: The food, service and atmosphere at this restaurant are all good; it's almost perfect.
why: Everything being good gives 十全十美 (perfect). The distractors are negative or lukewarm and clash with 都很好.

q: 他很有钱，这点房租对他来说只是___。
zh: 他很有钱，这点房租对他来说只是九牛一毛。
py: tā hěn yǒu qián zhè diǎn fáng zū duì tā lái shuō zhǐ shì jiǔ niú yī máo
en: He's rich; this bit of rent is a drop in the ocean for him.
why: A tiny amount compared with great wealth is 九牛一毛. 十全十美 means perfect and cannot describe a sum of money.

q: ___，我明天都要去机场送你。
zh: 无论如何，我明天都要去机场送你。
py: wú lùn rú hé wǒ míng tiān dōu yào qù jī chǎng sòng nǐ
en: No matter what, I'm going to the airport to see you off tomorrow.
why: 无论如何 opens the sentence and pairs with 都 before the verb. The others cannot introduce a firm resolve.

q: 这部电影的结尾很___，我看了两遍还是不懂。
zh: 这部电影的结尾很莫名其妙，我看了两遍还是不懂。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng de jié wěi hěn mò míng qí miào wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn hái shi bù dǒng
en: The ending of this film is baffling; I watched it twice and still don't get it.
why: Not understanding even after two viewings means the ending is baffling, 莫名其妙. The distractors are praise or approval and do not fit 不懂.

q: 他今天突然送我一束花，真让我觉得___。
zh: 他今天突然送我一束花，真让我觉得莫名其妙。
py: tā jīn tiān tū rán sòng wǒ yī shù huā zhēn ràng wǒ jué de mò míng qí miào
en: He suddenly gave me a bunch of flowers today, which left me puzzled.
why: A sudden gift with no explanation leaves one puzzled, 莫名其妙. The others cannot follow 觉得 in this sense.

q: 他一天读完三本书，对我来说简直___。
zh: 他一天读完三本书，对我来说简直不可思议。
py: tā yī tiān dú wán sān běn shū duì wǒ lái shuō jiǎn zhí bù kě sī yì
en: He finishes three books in a day; to me that's simply unbelievable.
why: 简直 plus amazement gives 不可思议. 理所当然 would say it is only natural, which 对我来说简直 does not.

q: 住在哪个城区我都___，只要离地铁站近就行。
zh: 住在哪个城区我都无所谓，只要离地铁站近就行。
py: zhù zài nǎ ge chéng qū wǒ dōu wú suǒ wèi zhǐ yào lí dì tiě zhàn jìn jiù xíng
en: I don't mind which district I live in, as long as it's close to a metro station.
why: 都无所谓 says every option is fine with me. 只要…就行 sets the only condition.

q: 这部电影到这里结束最好，后面又加了一段，真是___。
zh: 这部电影到这里结束最好，后面又加了一段，真是画蛇添足。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng dào zhè lǐ jié shù zuì hǎo hòu miàn yòu jiā le yī duàn zhēn shì huà shé tiān zú
en: The film should have ended here; tacking on another section afterwards just spoiled it.
why: Adding something unneeded that spoils a good result is 画蛇添足. 亡羊补牢 is fixing a loss, which is not what happened.

q: 你跟他讲古典音乐，就是___，他一点兴趣也没有。
zh: 你跟他讲古典音乐，就是对牛弹琴，他一点兴趣也没有。
py: nǐ gēn tā jiǎng gǔ diǎn yīn yuè jiù shì duì niú tán qín tā yī diǎn xìng qù yě méi yǒu
en: Talking classical music to him is wasted effort; he has no interest at all.
why: Telling something to someone who cannot or does not care to appreciate it is 对牛弹琴. 一点兴趣也没有 gives the reason.

q: 他一直坐在家里等好工作来找他，真是___。
zh: 他一直坐在家里等好工作来找他，真是守株待兔。
py: tā yī zhí zuò zài jiā li děng hǎo gōng zuò lái zhǎo tā zhēn shì shǒu zhū dài tù
en: He just sits at home waiting for a good job to come to him; he's waiting for luck to strike.
why: Passively waiting for luck is 守株待兔. 亡羊补牢 is repairing after a loss and involves action.

q: 邻居家被偷以后，小区才安上了新门锁，虽然晚了点，也算___。
zh: 邻居家被偷以后，小区才安上了新门锁，虽然晚了点，也算亡羊补牢。
py: lín jū jiā bèi tōu yǐ hòu xiǎo qū cái ān shàng le xīn mén suǒ suī rán wǎn le diǎn yě suàn wáng yáng bǔ láo
en: Only after the neighbours were burgled did the estate fit new locks; a bit late, but better late than never.
why: Fixing things after a loss is 亡羊补牢, and 虽然晚了点, 也算 shows it is still worth doing. 守株待兔 is passive waiting.

q: 他从没离开过这个小城，却说外面的世界不过如此，真是个___。
zh: 他从没离开过这个小城，却说外面的世界不过如此，真是个井底之蛙。
py: tā cóng méi lí kāi guò zhè ge xiǎo chéng què shuō wài miàn de shì jiè bù guò rú cǐ zhēn shì gè jǐng dǐ zhī wā
en: He has never left this town yet says the outside world is nothing special; a real frog in a well.
why: Someone who judges the world without having seen it is a 井底之蛙, a noun after 个. The other idioms cannot name a type of person.

q: 他说自己很喜欢安静，却天天把音乐开得很大声，这不是___吗？
zh: 他说自己很喜欢安静，却天天把音乐开得很大声，这不是自相矛盾吗？
py: tā shuō zì jǐ hěn xǐ huan ān jìng què tiān tiān bǎ yīn yuè kāi de hěn dà shēng zhè bù shì zì xiāng máo dùn ma
en: He says he likes quiet but plays his music loud every day; isn't that contradictory?
why: His words and his behaviour clash with each other, which is 自相矛盾. The other story idioms do not describe a contradiction.

q: 你对一个三岁的孩子讲这么多大道理，不是___吗？
zh: 你对一个三岁的孩子讲这么多大道理，不是对牛弹琴吗？
py: nǐ duì yī gè sān suì de hái zi jiǎng zhè me duō dà dào lǐ bù shì duì niú tán qín ma
en: Isn't it pointless to preach so many principles to a three-year-old?
why: A three-year-old cannot appreciate big principles, so talking is wasted: 对牛弹琴. 亡羊补牢 is about repairing a loss.

q: 想在这个城市找到好房子，不能在家里___，要多去看看。
zh: 想在这个城市找到好房子，不能在家里守株待兔，要多去看看。
py: xiǎng zài zhè ge chéng shì zhǎo dào hǎo fáng zi bù néng zài jiā li shǒu zhū dài tù yào duō qù kàn kan
en: To find a good flat in this city you can't just sit at home hoping; you must go and look.
why: Sitting at home waiting for luck is 守株待兔, and 要多去看看 gives the contrast. 亡羊补牢 would approve of fixing, not of passivity.

q: 这间屋子已经很漂亮了，再挂一幅画就成了___。
zh: 这间屋子已经很漂亮了，再挂一幅画就成了画蛇添足。
py: zhè jiān wū zi yǐ jīng hěn piào liang le zài guà yī fú huà jiù chéng le huà shé tiān zú
en: This room is already pretty; hanging one more picture would be overdoing it.
why: Adding to what is already good, and spoiling it, is 画蛇添足. The other story idioms do not mean spoiling by adding.

q: 他以前从不运动，生病以后才开始锻炼身体，这也是___。
zh: 他以前从不运动，生病以后才开始锻炼身体，这也是亡羊补牢。
py: tā yǐ qián cóng bù yùn dòng shēng bìng yǐ hòu cái kāi shǐ duàn liàn shēn tǐ zhè yě shì wáng yáng bǔ láo
en: He never exercised before; he only started after falling ill, but it's better late than never.
why: Taking action after a problem has appeared is 亡羊补牢, and it is still worthwhile. 守株待兔 is waiting passively, which he did not do.

q: 你下周要开车回老家，路上要小心，祝你___。
zh: 你下周要开车回老家，路上要小心，祝你一路平安。
py: nǐ xià zhōu yào kāi chē huí lǎo jiā lù shang yào xiǎo xīn zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
en: You're driving back to your home town next week; take care, and have a safe journey.
why: A wish for someone who is travelling is 祝你一路平安. The other sayings cannot follow 祝你.

q: 过年了，我给远方的朋友发信息：“祝你新年快乐，___！”
zh: 过年了，我给远方的朋友发信息：“祝你新年快乐，万事如意！”
py: guò nián le wǒ gěi yuǎn fāng de péng you fā xìn xī zhù nǐ xīn nián kuài lè wàn shì rú yì
en: It's New Year and I message a friend far away: “Happy New Year, and all the best!”
why: A general New Year wish is 万事如意 (everything as you wish). The other idioms are not wishes.

q: 别人都说那个古镇很美，我去了才知道，真是___。
zh: 别人都说那个古镇很美，我去了才知道，真是百闻不如一见。
py: bié rén dōu shuō nà ge gǔ zhèn hěn měi wǒ qù le cái zhī dào zhēn shì bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn
en: Everyone said that old town was beautiful, and only when I went did I understand: seeing is believing.
why: Hearing about it versus going there is exactly 百闻不如一见. 熟能生巧 is about practice.

q: 这首曲子我每天练一小时，现在弹得越来越好了，真是___。
zh: 这首曲子我每天练一小时，现在弹得越来越好了，真是熟能生巧。
py: zhè shǒu qǔ zi wǒ měi tiān liàn yī xiǎo shí xiàn zài tán de yuè lái yuè hǎo le zhēn shì shú néng shēng qiǎo
en: I practise this piece an hour every day and play it better and better; practice makes perfect.
why: Getting better through daily practice is 熟能生巧. 百闻不如一见 is about seeing for yourself.

q: 刚搬到新城市，当地人都吃得很辣，我也___，学着吃辣。
zh: 刚搬到新城市，当地人都吃得很辣，我也入乡随俗，学着吃辣。
py: gāng bān dào xīn chéng shì dāng dì rén dōu chī de hěn là wǒ yě rù xiāng suí sú xué zhe chī là
en: Having just moved to a new city where the locals eat very spicy food, I do as the Romans do and learn to eat spicy.
why: Adopting local customs in a new place is 入乡随俗, which is what 学着吃辣 shows. 一举两得 is about two gains from one action.

q: 骑自行车上班既省钱又锻炼身体，真是___。
zh: 骑自行车上班既省钱又锻炼身体，真是一举两得。
py: qí zì xíng chē shàng bān jì shěng qián yòu duàn liàn shēn tǐ zhēn shì yī jǔ liǎng dé
en: Cycling to work saves money and keeps you fit; it kills two birds with one stone.
why: Two benefits from one action, 既…又…, is 一举两得. The other sayings do not describe a double gain.

q: 去外地旅行前，朋友对我说：“___，到了给我发信息。”
zh: 去外地旅行前，朋友对我说：“一路平安，到了给我发信息。”
py: qù wài dì lǚ xíng qián péng you duì wǒ shuō yī lù píng ān dào le gěi wǒ fā xìn xī
en: Before my trip out of town, my friend said: “Have a safe journey, and message me when you arrive.”
why: The speaker is about to travel, so the farewell wish is 一路平安, and 到了给我发信息 fits it.

q: 住进新家以后，我们参加了邻居的聚会，既认识了朋友又练习了汉语，真是___。
zh: 住进新家以后，我们参加了邻居的聚会，既认识了朋友又练习了汉语，真是一举两得。
py: zhù jìn xīn jiā yǐ hòu wǒ men cān jiā le lín jū de jù huì jì rèn shi le péng you yòu liàn xí le hàn yǔ zhēn shì yī jǔ liǎng dé
en: After moving into the new home we went to the neighbours' party, making friends and practising Chinese at once; two birds with one stone.
why: Two gains from one party is 一举两得. The distractors are negative judgments and do not fit two benefits.

q: 在旧货市场买东西，大家都喜欢和老板___。
zh: 在旧货市场买东西，大家都喜欢和老板讨价还价。
py: zài jiù huò shì chǎng mǎi dōng xi dà jiā dōu xǐ huan hé lǎo bǎn tǎo jià huán jià
en: At the second-hand market everyone likes to haggle with the stallholders.
why: 和老板 + 讨价还价 (还 is huán) is haggling with someone. The distractors cannot follow 和老板.

q: 书店里有___的书，从小说到漫画都有。
zh: 书店里有各种各样的书，从小说到漫画都有。
py: shū diàn li yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de shū cóng xiǎo shuō dào màn huà dōu yǒu
en: The bookshop has all kinds of books, from novels to comics.
why: From novels to comics means many kinds: 各种各样的 before the noun. 一模一样的书 would mean identical books, which contradicts the range.

q: 他一个人坐在公园里___，好像在背课文。
zh: 他一个人坐在公园里自言自语，好像在背课文。
py: tā yī gè rén zuò zài gōng yuán li zì yán zì yǔ hǎo xiàng zài bèi kè wén
en: He sat alone in the park muttering to himself, as if learning a text by heart.
why: Alone and talking, as if reciting, is 自言自语. 讨价还价 needs someone to haggle with, which 一个人 rules out, and 脱口而出 needs a remark that slips out.

q: 我没想清楚，那句话就___了，现在很后悔。
zh: 我没想清楚，那句话就脱口而出了，现在很后悔。
py: wǒ méi xiǎng qīng chu nà jù huà jiù tuō kǒu ér chū le xiàn zài hěn hòu huǐ
en: I hadn't thought it through and the remark just slipped out; now I regret it.
why: Saying something without thinking, followed by regret, is 脱口而出. 自言自语 is talking to oneself and does not cause regret.

q: 这两个杯子颜色大小都___，我分不出哪个是我的。
zh: 这两个杯子颜色大小都一模一样，我分不出哪个是我的。
py: zhè liǎng gè bēi zi yán sè dà xiǎo dōu yī mú yī yàng wǒ fēn bù chū nǎ ge shì wǒ de
en: These two cups are exactly alike in colour and size; I can't tell which is mine.
why: Not being able to tell them apart means they are identical, 一模一样 (模 is mú). 各种各样 would mean many kinds.

q: 我和哥哥的手机___，所以常常拿错。
zh: 我和哥哥的手机一模一样，所以常常拿错。
py: wǒ hé gē ge de shǒu jī yī mú yī yàng suǒ yǐ cháng cháng ná cuò
en: My brother's phone and mine are identical, so we often pick up the wrong one.
why: Picking up the wrong phone is the result of identical phones, 一模一样. 各种各样 would mean different kinds, which would not cause the confusion.

q: 她和卖水果的阿姨___了半天，最后便宜了两块钱。
zh: 她和卖水果的阿姨讨价还价了半天，最后便宜了两块钱。
py: tā hé mài shuǐ guǒ de ā yí tǎo jià huán jià le bàn tiān zuì hòu pián yi le liǎng kuài qián
en: She haggled with the fruit seller for ages and got two yuan off in the end.
why: Getting a price cut after a long exchange is 讨价还价, with 和 + person. The others do not produce a lower price.

q: 这两个房间的布置___一模一样。
zh: 这两个房间的布置一模一样。
py: zhè liǎng gè fáng jiān de bù zhì yī mú yī yàng
en: The decoration of these two rooms is exactly the same.
why: 一模一样 already means exactly the same, so 很 cannot be added. Leave the blank empty and use it bare.

q: 他___那个女孩一见钟情了。
zh: 他对那个女孩一见钟情了。
py: tā duì nà ge nǚ hái yī jiàn zhōng qíng le
en: He fell for that girl at first sight.
why: 一见钟情 takes no object, so the person is introduced by 对 before it. 把 and a bare noun both put the girl in the wrong slot.

q: 买菜的时候，妈妈总是___卖菜的人讨价还价。
zh: 买菜的时候，妈妈总是和卖菜的人讨价还价。
py: mǎi cài de shí hou mā ma zǒng shì hé mài cài de rén tǎo jià huán jià
en: When shopping for vegetables, Mum always haggles with the seller.
why: 讨价还价 takes no direct object, so the other party is introduced with 和 (or 跟). 把 would turn the seller into the thing being handled.

q: 他从不出远门，却看不起别的城市，简直就是一只___。
zh: 他从不出远门，却看不起别的城市，简直就是一只井底之蛙。
py: tā cóng bù chū yuǎn mén què kàn bù qǐ bié de chéng shì jiǎn zhí jiù shì yī zhī jǐng dǐ zhī wā
en: He never travels far yet looks down on other cities; he's simply a frog in a well.
why: After 一只 a noun is needed, and 井底之蛙 is the noun idiom for a narrow-minded person. The others are not nouns for people.

q: 世界上没有___的家庭，每个家庭都有小矛盾。
zh: 世界上没有十全十美的家庭，每个家庭都有小矛盾。
py: shì jiè shàng méi yǒu shí quán shí měi de jiā tíng měi gè jiā tíng dōu yǒu xiǎo máo dùn
en: There is no perfect family in the world; every family has small quarrels.
why: 十全十美 + 的 before a noun means perfect, which matches 都有小矛盾. The other idioms cannot modify 家庭.

q: 孩子们___兴高采烈地唱着歌。
zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地唱着歌。
py: hái zi men xìng gāo cǎi liè de chàng zhe gē
en: The children were singing in high spirits.
why: 兴高采烈 is already extreme, so it does not take 很 or 太. Use it bare before 地 and the verb.

s: 我一见钟情了那个歌手。
s_py: wǒ yī jiàn zhōng qíng le nà ge gē shǒu
zh: 我对那个歌手一见钟情了。
py: wǒ duì nà ge gē shǒu yī jiàn zhōng qíng le
en: I fell for that singer at first sight.
why: 一见钟情 cannot take a direct object. The person goes in front with 对.

s: 这两家店的牌子很一模一样。
s_py: zhè liǎng jiā diàn de pái zi hěn yī mú yī yàng
zh: 这两家店的牌子一模一样。
py: zhè liǎng jiā diàn de pái zi yī mú yī yàng
en: The signs of these two shops are exactly the same.
why: 一模一样 already means exactly the same, so 很 in front of it is wrong.

s: 妈妈在菜市场讨价还价卖菜的人。
s_py: mā ma zài cài shì chǎng tǎo jià huán jià mài cài de rén
zh: 妈妈在菜市场跟卖菜的人讨价还价。
py: mā ma zài cài shì chǎng gēn mài cài de rén tǎo jià huán jià
en: Mum haggles with the vegetable seller at the market.
why: 讨价还价 takes no object; the other party needs 跟 or 和 before the idiom.

s: 他很井底之蛙，从来没离开过这个村子。
s_py: tā hěn jǐng dǐ zhī wā cóng lái méi lí kāi guò zhè ge cūn zi
zh: 他是只井底之蛙，从来没离开过这个村子。
py: tā shì zhī jǐng dǐ zhī wā cóng lái méi lí kāi guò zhè ge cūn zi
en: He's a frog in a well; he has never left this village.
why: 井底之蛙 is a noun, so it follows 是 plus a measure word, not 很.

s: 孩子们很兴高采烈地跑进了新房子。
s_py: hái zi men hěn xìng gāo cǎi liè de pǎo jìn le xīn fáng zi
zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地跑进了新房子。
py: hái zi men xìng gāo cǎi liè de pǎo jìn le xīn fáng zi
en: The children ran into the new house in high spirits.
why: 兴高采烈 is already extreme and does not take 很.

s: 明天你要参加考试，祝你一路平安！
s_py: míng tiān nǐ yào cān jiā kǎo shì zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
zh: 明天你要参加考试，祝你一切顺利！
py: míng tiān nǐ yào cān jiā kǎo shì zhù nǐ yī qiè shùn lì
en: You have an exam tomorrow; I wish you all the best!
why: 一路平安 is only said to someone setting off on a journey, and an exam is not a trip. Wish someone sitting an exam 一切顺利 (or 考试顺利).

s: 弟弟拿到新手机，七上八下地玩了一整天。
s_py: dì di ná dào xīn shǒu jī qī shàng bā xià de wán le yī zhěng tiān
zh: 弟弟拿到新手机，兴高采烈地玩了一整天。
py: dì di ná dào xīn shǒu jī xìng gāo cǎi liè de wán le yī zhěng tiān
en: Having got a new phone, my brother played with it happily all day.
why: 七上八下 is anxiety, never joy. A child delighted by a new phone is 兴高采烈.

s: 他从不复习，只盼着考试正好考他会的题，真是亡羊补牢。
s_py: tā cóng bù fù xí zhǐ pàn zhe kǎo shì zhèng hǎo kǎo tā huì de tí zhēn shì wáng yáng bǔ láo
zh: 他从不复习，只盼着考试正好考他会的题，真是守株待兔。
py: tā cóng bù fù xí zhǐ pàn zhe kǎo shì zhèng hǎo kǎo tā huì de tí zhēn shì shǒu zhū dài tù
en: He never revises and just hopes the exam happens to ask what he knows; pure waiting for luck.
why: Hoping luck will hand you the questions you know is 守株待兔. 亡羊补牢 means fixing things after a loss, and he is not fixing anything.

s: 他检查文件一丝不苟，错了好几个字也没发现。
s_py: tā jiǎn chá wén jiàn yī sī bù gǒu cuò le hǎo jǐ gè zì yě méi fā xiàn
zh: 他检查文件马马虎虎，错了好几个字也没发现。
py: tā jiǎn chá wén jiàn mǎ ma hǔ hǔ cuò le hǎo jǐ gè zì yě méi fā xiàn
en: He checked the document carelessly and missed several wrong characters.
why: 一丝不苟 means meticulous; missing several errors shows carelessness, 马马虎虎.

s: 他的房间乱七八糟的，书和衣服都放得整整齐齐。
s_py: tā de fáng jiān luàn qī bā zāo de shū hé yī fu dōu fàng de zhěng zhěng qí qí
zh: 他的房间干干净净的，书和衣服都放得整整齐齐。
py: tā de fáng jiān gān gān jìng jìng de shū hé yī fu dōu fàng de zhěng zhěng qí qí
en: His room is spotless, with books and clothes put away neatly.
why: 乱七八糟 means a total mess, which contradicts everything being put away neatly.

s: 他把小说写到一半就不写了，真是全力以赴。
s_py: tā bǎ xiǎo shuō xiě dào yī bàn jiù bù xiě le zhēn shì quán lì yǐ fù
zh: 他把小说写到一半就不写了，真是半途而废。
py: tā bǎ xiǎo shuō xiě dào yī bàn jiù bù xiě le zhēn shì bàn tú ér fèi
en: He stopped writing the novel halfway; what a case of giving up midway.
why: Stopping halfway is 半途而废. 全力以赴 means giving everything and contradicts quitting.

s: 他对这座老城一见钟情，后来就留在那里工作了。
s_py: tā duì zhè zuò lǎo chéng yī jiàn zhōng qíng hòu lái jiù liú zài nà lǐ gōng zuò le
zh: 他对这座老城一见钟情，后来就留在那里工作了。
py: tā duì zhè zuò lǎo chéng yī jiàn zhōng qíng hòu lái jiù liú zài nà lǐ gōng zuò le
en: He fell for this old city at first sight and later stayed there to work.
why: Correct: 一见钟情 takes the place with 对 in front and no object after it.

s: 这两张地图完全一模一样。
s_py: zhè liǎng zhāng dì tú wán quán yī mú yī yàng
zh: 这两张地图完全一模一样。
py: zhè liǎng zhāng dì tú wán quán yī mú yī yàng
en: These two maps are completely identical.
why: Correct: 很 is wrong before 一模一样, but 完全 may strengthen it.

s: 她跟房东讨价还价，把房租降了两百块。
s_py: tā gēn fáng dōng tǎo jià huán jià bǎ fáng zū jiàng le liǎng bǎi kuài
zh: 她跟房东讨价还价，把房租降了两百块。
py: tā gēn fáng dōng tǎo jià huán jià bǎ fáng zū jiàng le liǎng bǎi kuài
en: She haggled with the landlord and got the rent down by two hundred yuan.
why: Correct: 跟 introduces the person, and 讨价还价 takes no object. Haggling with a landlord about rent is a fitting situation.

s: 他是个井底之蛙，以为自己的公司就是全世界。
s_py: tā shì gè jǐng dǐ zhī wā yǐ wéi zì jǐ de gōng sī jiù shì quán shì jiè
zh: 他是个井底之蛙，以为自己的公司就是全世界。
py: tā shì gè jǐng dǐ zhī wā yǐ wéi zì jǐ de gōng sī jiù shì quán shì jiè
en: He's a frog in a well, thinking his own company is the whole world.
why: Correct: 井底之蛙 is a noun, so it follows 是 with the measure 个, not 很. Thinking your small corner is the whole world is exactly its meaning.

s: 这部电影太不可思议了，我看了三遍。
s_py: zhè bù diàn yǐng tài bù kě sī yì le wǒ kàn le sān biàn
zh: 这部电影太不可思议了，我看了三遍。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng tài bù kě sī yì le wǒ kàn le sān biàn
en: This film is just incredible; I've watched it three times.
why: Correct: judgment idioms like 不可思议 do take 太…了 or 很, unlike 一模一样 or 兴高采烈.

s: 明天你要坐火车回老家，祝你一路平安！
s_py: míng tiān nǐ yào zuò huǒ chē huí lǎo jiā zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
zh: 明天你要坐火车回老家，祝你一路平安！
py: míng tiān nǐ yào zuò huǒ chē huí lǎo jiā zhù nǐ yī lù píng ān
en: You're taking the train back to your home town tomorrow; have a safe journey!
why: Correct: 一路平安 is the right wish for someone about to travel.

s: 听了老师的话，他才恍然大悟，原来自己一直弄错了。
s_py: tīng le lǎo shī de huà tā cái huǎng rán dà wù yuán lái zì jǐ yī zhí nòng cuò le
zh: 听了老师的话，他才恍然大悟，原来自己一直弄错了。
py: tīng le lǎo shī de huà tā cái huǎng rán dà wù yuán lái zì jǐ yī zhí nòng cuò le
en: After hearing the teacher, it suddenly dawned on him that he had had it wrong all along.
why: Correct: the teacher's words cause the sudden understanding, 恍然大悟, as this idiom needs a trigger.

s: 他心里七上八下地等着面试的结果。
s_py: tā xīn li qī shàng bā xià de děng zhe miàn shì de jié guǒ
zh: 他心里七上八下地等着面试的结果。
py: tā xīn li qī shàng bā xià de děng zhe miàn shì de jié guǒ
en: He waited for the interview result with a pounding heart.
why: Correct: 七上八下 is anxiety, and an interview result is a natural cause. 心里 and 地 before the verb are fine.

s: 她喜欢听各种各样的音乐，从摇滚到古典都听。
s_py: tā xǐ huan tīng gè zhǒng gè yàng de yīn yuè cóng yáo gǔn dào gǔ diǎn dōu tīng
zh: 她喜欢听各种各样的音乐，从摇滚到古典都听。
py: tā xǐ huan tīng gè zhǒng gè yàng de yīn yuè cóng yáo gǔn dào gǔ diǎn dōu tīng
en: She likes listening to all kinds of music, from rock to classical.
why: Correct: 各种各样 goes before 的 + noun, and the range from rock to classical matches its meaning.
